C: pakaraṇa：[nt．] an occasion； a literary work or exposition．
P: Pakaraṇa，（nt．） [fr．pa+kṛ] 1．performance，undertaking paragraph （of the law） D．I，98 （“offence”? see Dial．I．120）； S．III，91； Miln．189．-- 2．occasion Vin．I，44； II，75； III，20．-- 3．exposition，arrangement，literary work，composition，book； usually in titles only，viz．Abhidhamma° J．I，312； Dpvs．V，37； Kathāvatthu° Paṭṭhāna° Miln．12； Netti° one of the Canonical books （see netti）．（Page 379）
K:
pakaraṇa：ပကရဏ（န）
[ပ+ကရ+ယု]
（၁） အကြောင်း။ （၂） ကျမ်း၊ ကျမ်းဂန်။ （၃） အရာ၊ အရာဌာန။ （၄） ကောင်းစွာပြုခြင်း၊ တည်စေခြင်း၊ ထားခြင်း။ （၅） အကြောင်းအရာ။ ပကရဏဂတ-ကြည့်။
R:
pakaraṇa：ပ-ကရဏ （န） （ပ√ကရ်+ယု）
ပြုပြင်စီရင်ခြင်း။ အခွင့်အရာ။ အကြောင်းအရာ။ သုတ်။ ကျမ်း။
ဧတသ္မိံ ပကရဏေ၊ ဤသို့သော အရာ၌။ ပကရဏေ စေဝ ဝါစေသုံ၊ အဘိဓမ္မာကျမ်းတို့ကိုပင်လျှင် ပို့ချကုန်၏။
DOP: pakaraṇa m.n. [ S. prakaraṇa], 1. subject, matter; occasion; circumstances; D I 98, 10 (brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ kismiñci-d-eva ~e … raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājeyyuṃ; Sv 267, 19 : kismiñci-d-eva dose); S III 91, 6 (bhagavā kismiñci-d-eva ~e bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā; Spk II 297, 31 : kismiñci-d-eva kāraṇe); A IV 65, 18 (kismiñci-d-eva ~e, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se kāraṇe); Mil 189, 13 (koci puriso kismiñci-d-eva ~e aparajjhati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se karaṇe); — esp. etasmiṃ ~e, on this occasion; in this connection; Vin I 56, 5 (bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ ~e dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits etasmiṃ nidāne); III 20, 15 (bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ ~e bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Sudinnaṃ paṭipucchi; Sp 219, 8 : ettha Sudinnassa ajjhācāravītikkamo sikkhāpadapaññattiyā kāraṇattā nidānaṃ c’ eva ~aṃ cā ti vutto); — 2. a discussion, exposition, treatise; Vin V 143, 29* (cattāri ñāṇasatāni atthavase ~e); Paṭis-a 8, 18 foll. (paṭisambhidāmaggo eva ~aṃ paṭisambhidāmaggapakaraṇaṃ, pakārena karīyante vuccante ettha … gambhīrā atthā iti ~aṃ); Ap-a 491, 19 foll. (Kaccāyanappakaraṇaṃ Mahāniruttippakaraṇaṃ Nettippakaraṇan ti °-ttayaṃ saṅghamajjhe vyākāsi); Sadd 906, 29 (ṭīkānayo ti ṭīkāsu āgatā saddagati °’-antaranayo ti aññesu ~esu āgatā saddagati); — esp. (in the titles of) the seven books of the Abhidhamma piṭaka; Vin V 3, 5* (nikāye pañca vācesuṃ satta c’ eva ~e, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pakāraṇe, mc ?); Ja I 78, 6 (sattannaṃ ~ānaṃ sammasitaṭṭhānaṃ); Bv 24:6 (~e satta desento; Bv-a 259, 25 foll.: devānaṃ sattappakaraṇasaṅkhātaṃ abhidhammapiṭakaṃ desento); Sp 790, 4 (sattasu ~esu); Ps II 184, 28 (kathāvatthu nāma ~aṃ yamakaṃ nāma ~aṃ tato mahāpakaraṇaṃ paṭṭhānaṃ nāmā ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee kathāvatthupakaraṇaṃ nāma yamakaṃ nāma); Dhātuk 114, 7 (saṅgaho asaṅgaho ti ādīnaṃ hi vasena idaṃ ~aṃ cuddasavidhena vibhattan ti vuttaṃ); As 3, 21 foll.; — ifc see kathāvatthu- ( sv kathā 1 ), jātaka- ( sv jātaka 1 ), dhammasaṅganī̆- ( sv dhamma 3 ), dhātukathā- ( sv dhātu ), netti- ( sv netti 2 ), paṭisambhidāmagga- ( sv paṭisambhidā ), paṭṭhāna-, yamaka-, vibhaṅga-; — see also sattappakaraṇika ( sv satta 4 ).

P: Pakāra，[pa+kṛ， cp．last； but Sk．prakāra “similarity”] 1．make-up，getting up，fixing，arrangement，preparation，mode，way，manner J．II，222； DA．I，132； PvA．26，109，123，135，178，199； Sdhp．94，466．-- 2．ingredient，flavour，way of making （a food） tasty Sn．241 （kathappakāro tava āmagandho）； Miln．63．-- 3．（-°） of a kind，by way of，in nānā° （adj．） various，manifold J．I，52 （sakuṇā），278 （phalāni）； PvA．50； vutta° as said，the said Vism．42，44； PvA．136．（Page 379）

Pākāra，[cp．Epic Sk．prākāra，pa+ā+kṛ] an encircling wall，put up for obstruction and protection，a fence，rampart Vin．II，121 （3 kinds：made of bricks，of stone，or of wood，viz．iṭṭhakā°，silā，dāru°）； IV，266 （id．）； M．III，11； S．IV，194 （°toraṇa）； A．IV，107； V，195； J．I，63； II，50； VI，330 （mahā°），341 （+parikhā & aṭṭāla）； Pv．I，1013 （ayo°）； Miln．1； Vism．394 （=parikkhepa-pākāra）； DhA．III，441 （tiṇṇaṁ pākārānaṁ antare）； PvA．24，52； sāṇi° screen-fencing J．II，88； PvA．283．

--iṭṭhakā brick or tile of a wall J．III，446 （T．iṭṭhikā）．--parikkhitta surrounded by a wall DA．I，42．--parikkhepa a fencing Vism．74．（Page 449）

pākāra：ပါကာရ （ပ）
တံတိုင်း။ စောင်ရန်း။
DOP: 1 pa [ ts ], the sound ‘p’, the consonant ‘p’; Sadd 604, 20 (pa pha ba bha ma); 623, 17 foll. (po vissa vassa ca … vo passa: kāvaññaṃ); — °- kāra 1 , m. , the letter or sound ‘p’; Ja III 419, 25´ (asitāpaṅgī ti … ~aṃ vakāraṃ katvā vaṅgī ti pi pāṭho yeva, Ce, Ee so; Be ~assa; Se cakāraṃ ~aṃ katvā paṅgī ti); Sp 997, 28 (~assa c’ ettha vakāro kato ti veditabbo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee kutoci veditabbo); Sv 393, 19 (~assa pana bhakāro kato); — °- vagga , m. , the labial consonants; Sadd 606, 12 .

pākāra m. [ S. prākāra], an enclosure, wall, fence; a rampart; Abh 203 (~o varaṇo); Vin II 121, 4 (jantāgharaṃ aparikkhittaṃ hoti, anujānāmi bhikkhave parikkhipituṃ tayo ~e iṭṭhakāpākāraṃ silāpākāraṃ dārupākāran ti); D II 170, 17 foll. (Kusāvatī … rājadhāni sattahi ~ehi parikkhittā ahosi, eko ~o sovaṇṇamayo eko rūpiyamayo …); A IV 107, 24 (paccantime nagare ~o hoti ucco c’ eva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca); Ja I 201, 22 foll. (sālaṃ ~ena parikkhipitvā dvāraṃ yojetvā anto ~e vālukaṃ ākiritvā bahi ~e tālapantiṃ ropesuṃ); 504, 9 (Vesālinagaraṃ gāvutagāvutantare tīhi ~ehi parikkhittaṃ); V 213, 20* (nivesanaṃ … ~ena paṇḍumayena guttaṃ); VI 432, 2 (paṃsuṃ … udakena sannetvā ~aṃ cinanti); Ap 39, 7 (~aṃ kārayiṃ daḷhaṃ); Mil 66, 19 (yadā te saṅgāmo paccupaṭṭhito bhaveyya tadā tvaṃ parikhaṃ khaṇāpeyyasi ~aṃ kārāpeyyasi …); Vism 394, 16 (~o ti gehavihāragāmādīnaṃ parikkhepapākāro); Sp 748, 4 (dvīhi dvārehi yuttassa sudhāchadanamaṇḍapassa majjhe ~aṃ karonti); Dhp-a IV 104, 6 (gehaṃ sattahi ~ehi parikkhittaṃ); Nidd-a I 86, 20 (palighaṃ ukkhipitvā ~aṃ bhindanto parikhaṃ pakiritvā); Mhv 25:42 (~aṃ hani bāhunā); 36:2 (Mahāvihāre ~aṃ kārāpesi samantato); 58:56 (ullaṅghitvāna ~aṃ pavissa sahasā puraṃ); Sadd 493, 24 (~aṃ cinoti); — ifc see tiro-, para-, sāṇi-; — °- cinanaka , mfn. , who constructs a wall; Sadd 143, 17 (cinoti rāsīkarotī ti cetā, ~o puggalo, iṭṭhakavaḍḍhakī ti attho); — supākāra , mfn. , with an excellent rampart; Ja VI 276, 16* (passa nagaraṃ ~aṃ; 276, 20´ : kañcanapākāraparikkhittaṃ); — see also anupākāraṃ.

[ S. prakaroti], does; acts; makes, produces; induces, presses; pakaroti : S I 66, 14* (na hi nūna tādī ~oti pāpaṃ, Ce, Ee tādisaṃ karoti); It 21, 11* (pahūtam ariyo ~oti puññaṃ; It-a I 93, 11 : ~oti nipphādeti); Pv 36:22 (yo kīḷamāno ~oti pāpaṃ); Sp 219, 11 (kāraṇaṃ hi yasmā … ~oti ca naṃ kattuṃ ārabhati karoti yeva vā tasmā … pakaraṇaṃ cā ti vuccati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr pakaro ti ca); Sadd 509, 10 ; — pakubbati ( and pakrubbati): S I 24, 10* (na hi dhīrā ~anti); Thī 239 (yo … pāpakammaṃ ~ati); Ja III 253, 13* (aphalaṃ madhuraṃ vācaṃ yo mittesu ~ati); — part.pr. ( a ) pakubba(t), mfn. , A I 149, 27* (pāpakammaṃ ~ato) = Ja III 19, 5* ; ( b ) pakubbamāna, mfn. , Sn 790 (na-y-idha ~amāno; Nidd I 91, 3 foll.: puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ … akubbamāno ajanayamāno asañjanayamāno …; Pj II 527, 8 : puññābhisaṅkhārādīnaṃ akaraṇato na idha ~amāno ti vuccati); Ja IV 47, 12* (pharusāhi vācāhi ~amāno; 47, 16´ : ~amāno ti abhibhavanto) quoted Sadd 517, 15 (pakrubbamāno; 517, 20 : pakrubbamāno ti hiṃsamāno); — pakurute : Pj II 169, 15 (sante na kurute iti sante na sevatī ti attho yathā rājānaṃ sevatī ti etasmiṃ atthe rājānaṃ pakurute ti saddavidū mantenti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se piyaṃ kurute ti; cf Pāṇ 1:3:32); — pass. pr. 3 sg. pakariyati, pakariyyati, Ud-a 40, 32 (avijjādīhi ca saṅkhārādayo pabhavanti pakariyanti cā ti te tesaṃ pabhavo pakati ca, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ca kariyanti); Sadd 509, 16 (pakariyyati); — pp pakata , mfn. , 1. [ S. prakṛta] ( i ) made (of); done; produced; Abh 315; D III 171, 22* (~ena kammunā); S I 135, 8* (kenāyaṃ ~o satto kuvaṃ sattassa kārako); A I 136, 15* (yaṃ tena ~aṃ kammaṃ appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ); Sn 286 (yaṃ tesaṃ ~aṃ āsi dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ saddhāpakataṃ esānaṃ); Ja IV 4, 9* (kiṃ pāpaṃ ~aṃ mayā); 380, 12* (annaṃ tava idaṃ ~aṃ yassasi; 380, 16´ : ~an ti paṭiyattaṃ); VI 244, 3* (guṇā mam’ ete ~ā purāṇā; 244, 8´ foll.: mayā purimabhave katā ti dasseti); Nidd I 32, 23* (attanā ~aṃ pāpaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be hi kataṃ; Ce va kataṃ; quoting Dhp 165: Ce, Ee, Se va kataṃ; Be hi kataṃ); Mil 218, 12 (api nu kho taṃ mahārāja maṇiratanaṃ tassa ~an ti); Sadd 794, 17 (tena vatthunā ~am icc etasmiṃ atthe ca mayapaccayo hoti: suvaṇṇena ~aṃ suvaṇṇamayaṃ); 881, 29 (abhinipphanne ~aṃ); — ifc see dosa- ( sv dosa 2 ); — ( ii ) mentioned; (a rule) under discussion; Sadd 920, 15 ; — 2. induced; harrassed; pressed; beset by; Vin II 7, 19 (api ssu bhikkhū ~ā parivāsaṃ dentā mūlāya paṭikassantā …, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pakatattā; Sp 1157, 21 : ~ā ti api ssu bhikkhū niccavyāvaṭā honti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pakatattā ti); Th 271 (ahaṃ middhena ~o vihārā upanikkhamiṃ; Th-a II 112, 19 : middhena abhibhūto); Ja VI 515, 10* (kaccāmittehi ~o; 515, 15´ : ~o ti abhibhūto); 525, 15* (tumhehi brahme ~o atidānena khattiyo; 525, 19´ : ~o ti upadduto pīḷito); Mp II 209, 26 (lobhapakatan ti lobhena ~aṃ, lobhābhibhūtena luddhena hutvā katakamman ti attho); — ifc see ājīvikā-, icchā-, issā-, moha-, lobha-; — pakataṃ in Ce, Ee at Ud-a 324, 15 is wr for pākaṭaṃ ( Be, Se so ); — pakatā in Ee at Ud-a 260, 2 is wr for pākaṭā ( Be, Ce, Se so ).
